Nearing the end of the cast, the arrow will stop, but "slip" four more times until it stops on the next safe area, at which point the Unknown will blast that area with a narrow cone while the orbs explode. While the arrow is "slipping" it still safe to move, therefore, make your way to another spot before the circles AoE detonate.
